neighbours.label: the word stem 'reminisc-' (reminiscent, reminiscence, reminiscing, reminisce), on the stem's pieces; quiet on synonyms (remember, recall, resemble, memoir)
fire: The two brothers spent the whole evening reminiscing about their school days.
The building's facade is reminiscent of a Venetian palace.
His lecture ended with a short reminiscence of his first teacher.
Grandmother loved to reminisce about the dances of her youth.
The smell of the bakery was reminiscent of winter mornings in Vienna.
The nurses use reminiscence sessions to help patients with memory loss.
We found the veterans reminiscing over a box of faded photographs.
Her latest paintings are strongly reminiscent of the early Impressionists.
quiet: The two brothers spent the whole evening talking about their school days.
The building's facade resembles a Venetian palace.
His lecture ended with a short anecdote about his first teacher.
Grandmother loved to remember the dances of her youth.
The smell of the bakery reminded her of winter mornings in Vienna.
The nurses use memory sessions to help patients with dementia.
We found the veterans looking through a box of faded photographs.
Her latest paintings strongly recall the early Impressionists.

notes: Card: ' reminiscent' x9, 'iscing' x4, 'isc' x3, ' remin' x3 (plus Cyrillic 'ин'/'ина' x8, not tested). Probes: reminisc- words 0.41-0.99, synonyms and 'commemorative', 'nostalgia', 'recollection' under 0.01.
